title: webSocket: a late error event of an old socket closes the new connection (unsubscribe and subscribe while CONNECTING, timeout with retry)
note: onerror has no check of the current socket. PR #6708 added that check to onclose only. Confidence high.

title: webSocket: an exception of the serializer becomes the error 'WebSocketSubject.error must be called with an object with an error code'
note: With a code property on the error, close() throws and the subject is stuck. Confidence high.

title: webSocket: error({code, reason}) with a reason over 123 bytes or a code that close() refuses leaves the socket open and the subject stuck
note: close() throws, so _resetState is skipped and no subscriber gets an event. Confidence high.

title: webSocket multiplex: a throwing subMsg still subscribes and sends unsubMsg, and an error of unsubMsg is lost
note: No return after observer.error in the subMsg catch. Confidence high.

title: webSocket: closingObserver is not called for a close that unsubscription causes, the one case that its documentation names
note: Only complete() and error() call it. Confidence high.

title: webSocket: the deprecated resultSelector option is typed and documented, but nothing reads it
note: Unused since 6.x. Confidence high.

title: webSocket: an explicit undefined deserializer or serializer replaces the JSON default
note: The config copy keeps own keys with the value undefined. Confidence medium.

title: webSocket: an exception in openObserver or closeObserver leaves the subject stuck
note: The hooks run unwrapped in the event handlers. Confidence medium: the contract for hook errors is not documented.

title: webSocket: values buffered before a connection are dropped when the attempt fails, so retry() does not send them
note: The docs say that the values are sent when the connection is established. The 8.x rewrite also drops them, so the docs may be the fault. Confidence low.

title: webSocket multiplex: after a connection loss, the unsubMsg of a stream goes out on the new connection
note: Some protocols, for example STOMP, answer an unknown UNSUBSCRIBE with an error. Confidence medium.

title: webSocket: values buffered before open stay in memory for the life of the connection
note: The queue subscription is not unsubscribed after the replay. Confidence medium.

title: webSocket: with no global WebSocket and no WebSocketCtor, the constructor throws ReferenceError, not the error of the library
note: The check uses the bare name WebSocket. Confidence high.

title: presence: the key __proto__ replaces the prototype of presenceState() and hides that member
note: transformState builds a plain object with assignment. Only the returned object changes, not Object.prototype. Confidence high.

title: connect() adds the connection handlers again at each connect, also at each automatic reconnect
note: After 20 reconnects, one frame runs 21 message callbacks. Confidence high.

title: disconnect() resolves but keeps a timer of 10 seconds, so a Node process cannot exit for 10 seconds
note: The id of the timeout timer is not kept or cleared. Confidence high.

title: connect() or subscribe() while the socket closes does nothing, and the channel stays in CHANNEL_ERROR
note: The guard isDisconnecting() drops the request. Confidence high.

title: the first phx_join has no access token, and the token is not pushed after the join
note: A regression of #2136 from the phoenix migration. Confidence high.

title: when the push buffer overflows, the promise of the dropped push does not settle
note: Only cancelTimeout() runs on the dropped push. Confidence high.

title: httpSend keeps its timeout timer when the fetch rejects
note: clearTimeout runs only after a resolved fetch. Confidence high.

title: each push failure on a joined channel is reported as 'before joining', and the real error is lost
note: A catch-all throws a fixed message with no cause. Confidence high.

title: a Uint8Array or Buffer broadcast payload goes out as JSON over the socket, but as binary over HTTP
note: The docs name only ArrayBuffer. Confidence low.

title: a binary frame of an unknown kind throws a TypeError in onmessage
note: The server sends only kind 4 today. Confidence low.

title: the type HeartbeatStatus has 'disconnected', but the callbacks of the user do not get it
note: The filter is intentional (#2496). Only the type is stale. Confidence low.

title: the maxPayload check of a batch counts base64 as 1.33 bytes for each byte, so the server answers 413 and the client closes
note: Base64 gives 4*ceil(n/3) bytes. Confidence high.

title: the Fetch transport sends credentials 'omit', so it drops same-origin cookies and breaks sticky sessions
note: XHR sends same-origin cookies. Shown in headless Chrome. Confidence high.

title: Fetch transport: an error while it reads the body is an unhandled rejection, so polling stops with no error event
note: res.text() has no catch. In Node.js the process exits. Confidence high.

title: WebTransport: the promises ready, createBidirectionalStream, pipeTo and write reject unhandled
note: Confidence high for ready, medium for pipeTo.

title: the heartbeat timer overflows when pingInterval + pingTimeout is over 2^31-1, so the client closes with 'ping timeout' at once
note: The server accepts that configuration. Confidence high.

title: a malformed open packet throws out of the transport callback, with no error or close event, and the socket stays 'opening'
note: JSON.parse and the field reads are unchecked. Only a server that does not obey the protocol causes it. Confidence high.

title: requestTimeout has no effect with NodeXHR, the default polling transport in Node.js, or with Fetch
note: xmlhttprequest-ssl has no timeout, and Fetch gets no AbortSignal. Browser XHR obeys it. Confidence medium.

title: close does not abort the polling requests in flight: the long-poll GET and the close POST
note: Each held request keeps a connection slot of the origin. Confidence medium.

title: a failed probe is not closed: the probe WebSocket stays open, its listeners stay, and upgradeError fires twice
note: The else branch of _probe has no freezeTransport(). Confidence medium.

title: the types refuse perMessageDeflate: false and send(msg, fn), which the documentation and the runtime accept
note: The JSDoc default of perMessageDeflate is also wrong. Confidence high.

title: close during the polling handshake leaves a session on the server until 'ping timeout'
note: Reported before as #5274 (bug 2).

title: a close packet over WebSocket is ignored
note: Reported before as #5286.

title: close() in an 'upgrade' listener does not close the socket
note: Reported before as #5595.

title: In browsers, addEventListener listeners get close and error events with wrong fields: code "close", reason an Event object
note: cloneEventBrowser calls new e.constructor(e.type, e), but the own CloseEvent and ErrorEvent take other arguments. The upstream tests run only in Node and jsdom. Confidence high.

title: close(code, reason) with a code or reason that the WebSocket rejects leaves the inner socket open, and the error is lost
note: Since 1.2.0, _disconnect swallows the exception. readyState says CLOSED, send() still sends, and no close event comes. Confidence high.

title: reconnect() on an open socket stops itself when shouldReconnectOnClose returns false for its own close event
note: New in 1.3.0. The predicate is for automatic reconnects only. Different from the open issue #428. Confidence high.

title: A URL or query provider that rejects with undefined or null gives an unhandled rejection, no error event and no retry
note: Error(err.message) throws a TypeError inside the catch. The socket stays in CONNECTING. Confidence high.

title: updateProperties() throws "path must not start with a slash" on each PartySocket that was made with path
note: The constructor adds a slash to this.path, and updateProperties passes it back. Confidence high.

title: A second updateProperties() call undoes the first, and the id changes on each call
note: The merge uses the options of the constructor, which never change. A call with no id makes a new _pk. Confidence high for the undo, medium for the id.

title: React usePartySocket: after a mount with enabled false and a later enable, the first change of the options is ignored
note: The branch from false to true does not set socketInitializedRef. Related to the open issue #422, with a different cause. Confidence high.

title: Node and React Native: listeners get the reason "unknown reason" for an empty reason, and wasClean is always true
note: cloneEvent puts defaults on code and reason, and the own CloseEvent sets wasClean to true. Confidence high.

title: close() before the inner socket exists dispatches no close event
note: This occurs in the first tick, while a URL provider is pending, and during a backoff wait. The doc comment promises a terminal event. Confidence medium.

title: An on* handler that throws stops the addEventListener listeners, and an onclose that throws inside close() is lost
note: Inherited from reconnecting-websocket. The DOM reports the exception and runs the other listeners. Confidence medium.

title: The default reconnect delay has no jitter (3000 ms for each client), and the README tells a random default
note: PR #397 replaced the random value with a fixed midpoint and did not change the README. After a server restart, all clients connect at the same times. Confidence high.

title: reconnect() during a backoff wait does not connect until the old delay ends
note: _connectLock is held during _wait. Inherited from reconnecting-websocket. Confidence medium.

title: close() does not clear the backoff timer, so a Node process stays alive until the delay ends
note: The handle of the timer is not kept, so _clearTimeouts cannot clear it. Severity low. Confidence high.

title: room and party are not URL-encoded: a room with ? or # goes to the wrong room, or retries without end
note: Only a slash gives a warning. The server side must decode too. Confidence medium.

title: With no global crypto, new PartySocket() with no id throws ReferenceError
note: crypto?.randomUUID does not protect against a name that is not declared, so the fallback never runs. This occurs on React Native without a polyfill. Confidence high.

title: The types of partysocket/ws need the DOM lib
note: The declarations use AddEventListenerOptions, EventListenerOrEventListenerObject and BinaryType. The fault shows with skipLibCheck false. Confidence high.

title: The onError of the React hooks has the type Event, so e.message does not compile
note: use-handlers.ts uses the global WebSocketEventMap, not the own map of partysocket. Confidence high.

title: PartySocket.fetch needs room in its type also when basePath is given
note: getPartyInfo uses basePath in place of room, and the constructor accepts the same options with no room. Confidence medium.

title: A volatile event emitted while the namespace is not connected is buffered and sent after connect, not dropped
note: The check of the discard looks only at the transport. During the namespace handshake the transport is writable. Confidence high.

title: A dropped volatile packet keeps its ack handler: the handler leaks, and emitWithAck never settles
note: _registerAckCallback runs before the discard, and the discard never removes the handler. Confidence high.

title: socket.connect() during a pending namespace handshake sends a second CONNECT
note: With WebSocket the server gets an orphan socket. With polling the server closes the whole connection, so each namespace drops. Confidence high.

title: disconnect() during the namespace handshake leaves an orphan socket on the server
note: No DISCONNECT goes out, and the later CONNECT reply is ignored. A DISCONNECT sent at once makes the 4.8 server close the connection. Confidence high.

title: reconnectionAttempts 0, reconnectionDelay 0 and reconnectionDelayMax 0 in the constructor become the defaults
note: The constructor and backo2 use ||. The setters accept 0. randomizationFactor was fixed with ?? in #1231. Confidence high.

title: socket.recovered is undefined, not false, when the server does not use connection state recovery
note: The field has the type boolean. Low impact. Confidence high.

title: url() with no scheme in Node.js or React Native gives "undefined//host"
note: loc becomes false, so the check of typeof is always true and the https fallback never runs. Low impact. Confidence high.

title: socket.timeout(ms).emitWithAck() returns Promise<any>, and the type tests of the package do not run
note: FirstArg does not match the callback with two arguments. test:types is "exit 0", so the type test of the repository for this case never runs. Confidence high.

title: After about 1,015 reconnect attempts the backoff delay overflows to Infinity, and with jitter it drops near 0
note: Known upstream. The repro of this review shows 6 of 10 gaps under 200 ms after attempt 1031.

title: retries without ackTimeout: a positive ack goes to the callback as the error, and the event is sent three times
note: Known upstream. Related, different: issue #5446.

title: The retries queue keeps this.flags, so a later emit gets the timeout of an earlier one
note: Known upstream. The retries branch returns before this.flags = {}.

title: Connection state recovery: a volatile event with a string as its last argument becomes the offset, so recovery fails
note: Known upstream. PR #5547 (open) is a fix on the client side.

title: The decoder of the client allows 10 attachments, but the server sends more: an event with 11 buffers gives a parse error and a reconnect
note: Known upstream. The Manager makes the Decoder with no options.
